name: mediaflow-web
description: MediaFlow Web - premium authorized media downloader and converter

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push
